items.name: animated-theme-toggler
items.title: Animated Theme Toggler
items.description: A shape-based theme toggler using clip-path transitions (circle, square, triangle, diamond, hexagon, rectangle, star) with the View Transitions API.

items.name: theme-toggle-button
items.title: Theme Toggle Button
items.description: A button with text cycling (Light/Dark) that supports multiple transition animations (fade, slide, scale, blur, flip) via the View Transitions API.

items.name: theme-toggle-switch
items.title: Theme Toggle Switch
items.description: An iOS-style toggle switch for theme switching with multiple transition animations (fade, slide, scale, blur, flip) via the View Transitions API.

items.name: theme-switcher
items.title: Theme Switcher
items.description: A segmented System/Light/Dark theme switcher with a sliding indicator and multiple transition animations via the View Transitions API.
